title.narrative: Fraport TAV Antalya Yatirim,Yapim ve Isletme A.S.

description.narrative: Fraport TAV Antalya Yatirim,Yapim ve Isletme A.S. (the Company) is a Turkish joint-stock company owned by TAV Havalimanlari Holding Anonim Sirketi (TAV Airports) and Fraport AG Frankfurt Airport Services Worldwide (Fraport), respectively. On December 28, 2021, the Company entered into a 25-year Lease Agreement with the General Directorate of State Airports Authority (DHMI), for the operations and expansion of Antalya Airport (ICAO: AYT), starting on 1st of January 2027. Antalya airport is one of the largest leisure-oriented airports in Europe, with a current capacity of circa 40 million passengers. The Project entails the expansion of the Antalya Airport to a capacity of approximately 80 million in three phases.

IFC expects the Project to generate significant stakeholder impacts in terms of improved access and quality of the airport's landside and airside services, as well as positive government revenue and economy-wide impacts derived both from the operation and from the activities enabled mainly in the aviation and tourism sectors. The anticipated market creation effect is to preserve Türkiye's role in the global and regional tourism market.
